exercises.name: Easy bike or brisk walk
exercises.instructions: Start at a conversational pace. Aim to feel warmer, not tired, before strength work.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switches
exercises.instructions: Sit with both knees bent at roughly 90°. Rotate them side to side slowly, keeping the movement comfortable and avoiding a forced stretch.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent. Exhale, press through your heels and lift your hips without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Goblet squat to box
exercises.instructions: Hold one dumbbell at chest height. Sit back to a box or bench, keep pressure through both feet, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: Keep knees soft, move hips backward and lower weights close to your legs. Stand by driving through your feet.

exercises.name: Supported split squat
exercises.instructions: Use a rail or bench for balance. Lower straight down through a short comfortable range, keeping your pelvis level.

exercises.name: Lateral band walk
exercises.instructions: Place a light band above your knees. Take small sideways steps without letting your knees cave in or torso sway.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent. Exhale, extend opposite arm and leg, and keep your low back steady.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Kneel on a padded surface. Gently tuck your pelvis and shift forward a little until you feel a mild front-hip stretch.

exercises.name: Easy bike or brisk walk
exercises.instructions: Start at a conversational pace. Aim to feel warmer, not tired, before strength work.

exercises.name: Thoracic open book rotation
exercises.instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent. Rotate your upper arm and chest open, following your hand with your eyes.

exercises.name: Wall slide
exercises.instructions: With forearms on a wall, slide upward slowly without shrugging or arching your back. Stay within a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip dumbbell floor press
exercises.instructions: Lie on the floor with palms facing in. Lower elbows gently to the floor, then press without flaring your ribs.

exercises.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
exercises.instructions: Rest your chest on an incline bench. Pull elbows toward your hips, pause, and lower under control.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.instructions: Hands on a sturdy bench or wall. Keep your body in one line, lower slowly, and press away without shoulder discomfort.

exercises.name: Band external shoulder rotation at side
exercises.instructions: Keep elbow lightly against your ribs. Rotate your forearm outward against a light band without twisting your trunk.

exercises.name: Serratus wall slide
exercises.instructions: Forearms on the wall, gently push into it and slide upward. Let shoulder blades rotate naturally; avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, reach opposite arm and leg long. Pause while keeping hips and shoulders square.

exercises.name: Doorway pec stretch
exercises.instructions: Place your forearm on a doorframe below shoulder height and gently turn away. Avoid tingling or pinching.

exercises.name: Easy bike or brisk walk
exercises.instructions: Start at a conversational pace. Aim to feel warmer, not tired, before strength work.

exercises.name: Cat cow
exercises.instructions: On hands and knees, alternate between gently rounding and extending your spine. Move smoothly, not to end range.

exercises.name: Bodyweight reverse lunge
exercises.instructions: Step back and lower a short distance. Use support if needed and keep front knee tracking over your foot.

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up
exercises.instructions: Use a low stable step. Push through the lead foot to stand; lower slowly without dropping your hip.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row
exercises.instructions: Support one hand on a bench. Pull the dumbbell toward your hip while keeping your torso still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Rest your upper back against a stable bench, feet planted. Lift hips until trunk and thighs align, without overextending.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip dumbbell bench press
exercises.instructions: Press with palms facing each other. Keep feet planted and use a pain-free shoulder range.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.instructions: Stand sideways to a band anchor. Press hands forward and resist being pulled into rotation.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
exercises.instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your side and walk slowly. Keep shoulders and pelvis level; avoid leaning.

exercises.name: Standing calf stretch
exercises.instructions: Hands on a wall, one leg back with heel down. Lean forward gently until you feel a mild calf stretch.
